label: Agent: Create
description: Mint a voice agent on the account: name, system prompt, first message, voice, language. The agent id works in Agent: Place Call; manage it at elevenlabs.io/app/agents.

inputs.name: account
inputs.description: Your own ElevenLabs account (the minted agent lives in it; the shared credential cannot serve this).

inputs.name: name
inputs.description: The agent's name on the account.

inputs.name: prompt
inputs.description: The agent's system prompt: who it is, what it does, how it talks. {{variables}} are filled per call.
inputs.placeholder: You are a friendly booking assistant for...

inputs.name: firstMessage
inputs.description: What the agent says first. Absent = it waits for the caller.

inputs.name: voice
inputs.label: Voice
inputs.placeholder: Pick a voice, or paste a voice id

outputs.name: agentId
outputs.description: The minted agent's id: what Agent: Place Call takes.
